description:
[Calculators] Circuit simulator parts: every electrical part's inputs, outputs and rules. The parts and rules behind https://rust.wiki/calculators/circuit-simulator (Rust's power rules since the April
2024 rework): `parts` as [kind, name, shortname, group, inputs, outputs, settings], `devices` as [name, shortname,
power draw], `rules` and `caveats`. The board and its solver run in the browser - build circuits on the page;
for a plain power budget use /calculators/electricity/compute.
name: get_circuit_parts
title: Circuit simulator parts: every electrical part's inputs, outputs and rules
